title: Blocking Bounded Queue
hints: `wait(lock, condition)` checks the condition, sleeps if it is false, and checks again each time it wakes, so spurious wake-ups do no harm (lesson 12.03).
Close the queue only after both producers have finished (join them first). The consumers then drain what is left and get an empty `optional`, which ends their loops.
requirements: `BlockingQueue<T>` with capacity; `push` blocks when full, `pop` blocks when empty (two condition variables)
Multiple producers & consumers test: every item delivered exactly once (checksum)
